content_identity.same_values_as: the four digests already on model_resource; no second digest scheme is introduced here
content_identity.use_as: the cache key for this tree: it changes only when the frozen bundle content changes

caching.fetch_rule: request this once per content_identity_sha256 — on first load or when that value changes — and omit include_model_tree on later per-frame robot-state requests
caching.etag_note: this response also carries retrieved_at and the selected frame's pose, so a mesh-content ETag must not be attached to or compared against the whole robot-state response

semantics.links: the frozen compiled reference layout: parent_name, joint name/type/axis, local_transform as the body offset in the parent body frame, and every geom with type, size, transform, rgba and mesh_asset_id
semantics.world_links_note: a world link carrying a task object is shown where the model was compiled, not where the record says it was during this Episode; dynamic_scene_objects stays missing until it is attested

mesh_bytes: geoms[].mesh_asset_id resolves against model_resource.assets[]; bytes only from GET /api/v1/episodes/{episode_id}/model/assets/{asset_id}, never from the live scene asset route
